record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: For the differential equation ż = iz + (z z̄)^n z^{k+1} with positive integers n and k, determine whether the period function on the period annulus of the origin is always monotonically decreasing.

evidence.quote: Problem 16. Is the period function associated to the period annulus of the origin of the diﬀerential equation ˙z = iz + (z¯z)nzk+1, with n and k a positive integers, monotonous decreasing?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the planar differential equation in the complex variable $z\in\mathbb{C}$ given by
$$\dot z = iz + (z\bar z)^{n}\, z^{k+1},$$
where $n,k$ are positive integers. The origin is a center, and it is surrounded by a maximal punctured neighborhood (the period annulus) entirely foliated by periodic orbits. To each periodic orbit one associates its minimal period, giving the period function $T$ on the period annulus, parametrized (e.g.) by an energy or by the amplitude along a transverse section.

Determine whether, for every choice of positive integers $n$ and $k$, the period function $T$ on the period annulus of the origin is strictly monotonically decreasing.
artifact.status_search_result: A 2025 paper by Gasull and Rojas in the Mediterranean Journal of Mathematics, "Monotonous Period Function for Equivariant Differential Equations with Homogeneous Nonlinearities," proves that for the $\mathbb{Z}_k$-equivariant equation $\dot z = iz + a(z\bar z)^n z^{k+1}$ with $a\neq 0$, the period function of the center at the origin is monotonically decreasing, giving a positive answer to the conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Monotonous Period Function for Equivariant Differential Equations with Homogeneous Nonlinearities
status_evidence.snippet: The period function of the center at the origin of the Z_k-equivariant differential equation ż = iz + a(z̄z)^n z^(k+1), a ≠ 0, is monotonous decreasing. ... main result is a positive answer to such conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture is proved positively for all positive integers n,k.

status_evidence.title: Gasull–Rojas SSRN preprint
status_evidence.snippet: Monotonous Period Function for Equivariant Differential Equations with Homogeneous Nonlinearities by Armengol Gasull, David Rojas
status_evidence.claim: Preprint version of the paper resolving the problem.
